slides.title: Meta's AI wants to run your marketing.
slides.sub: Muse for Small Business just launched in the US. Here is what it does, and the one thing it can't fix for you.

slides.title: It works in the background
slides.body: Give Muse a goal, like finding new customers. It drafts posts, emails and ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram and your ad account.

slides.title: It plugs into your tools
slides.body: Shopify, QuickBooks, Stripe, Canva, Klaviyo and more. Free for most uses, with paid plans if you want extra.

slides.title: You still hit approve
slides.body: Meta says nothing publishes, sends or spends money without your approval. You stay the final editor.

slides.title: It learns your brand voice
slides.body: Muse starts by learning what you sell and how you sound. If your brand is unclear, it scales unclear.

slides.title: Fix the foundation first
slides.body: A clear logo, colors, fonts and a website that tells your story give AI something worth repeating.

slides.title: AI amplifies. Your brand decides what gets amplified.
slides.body: Blackwell Graphics builds brand identities and websites for Black-owned businesses, so every tool you use, AI included, has a strong brand to work from.
